description: Fork of exp303 (SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Three coordinated trades: residual_input_nap 6 -> 5, residual_tph 2048 -> 4096, plus sparse_scatter with per-table n_outputs=64 fanning out to D=384. Holds residual_lut params/layer at 8.4M (matches exp315 exactly: 4096*32*64 == 2048*64*64). Direct A/B vs exp315: same entry budget, same n_sparse, wide-vs-deep test under sparsity. Tables/D-slot 341 -> 683 at same entry budget per slot (21,845). Tests if the wide-beats-deep rule from `project_residual_lut_prefers_more_tables` (validated dense) holds under sparse residual_lut. If wide wins -> NAP=5 wide-sparse is the new design knob; if deep wins -> sparsity changes the rule.
